request.deadline: Enactment described as only valid at Epoch 653, with new terms expiring at Epoch 799.
deliverables: Appoint Marek Mahut, Phil_uplc/Philip DiSarro, Leandros BSP, and Cardano Curia to terms expiring at Epoch 799.
Remove or replace the seats associated with credentials expiring at Epoch 653.
Keep the committee signature threshold at 2/3.
Leave Eastern Cardano Council, Tingvard, and Ace Alliance unchanged.
request.what: Update the Cardano Constitutional Committee by replacing expiring seats and appointing the 2026 election winners.

claims.claim: The action updates four Constitutional Committee seats whose terms expire at the end of Epoch 653 by appointing candidates elected in the 2026 Constitutional Committee election.
The incoming members are Marek Mahut, Phil_uplc, Leandros BSP, and Cardano Curia, each with a 146-epoch term ending at Epoch 799.
The election results list Philip DiSarro, Leandros BSP, Marek Mahut, and Cardano Curia as the top four candidates by voting power.
The election process included candidate registration, a DRep voting period, a voting power snapshot, an independent audit, and publication of audited results.
The results of the DRep vote were independently audited by DQuadrant.
The action keeps the Constitutional Committee signature threshold at 2/3.
The document states that the action can only be enacted at Epoch 653 because earlier enactment would exceed the 146-epoch committeeMaxTermLength limit.
The document states that re-elected members Cardano Curia and Phil_uplc receive fresh maximum-length terms and that prior service does not count toward the 146-epoch limit.
The action includes a 100000000000 lovelace deposit and a stated reward account, with no treasury withdrawal requested.
The document provides credentials for incoming members but does not provide candidate track records or conflict-of-interest disclosures.

summary: The document describes a non-treasury Constitutional Committee update based on a 2026 election, with credential-level implementation details, election results, audit references, timing rationale, and retained 2/3 quorum, but it lacks candidate track-record and conflict-of-interest evidence.
